title: AXe 2.0: snapshot-scoped actions on Simulators and real devices
summary: Cameron Cooke demonstrates compact screen observations, snapshot-scoped controls, folded-device inspection, and real-iPhone interaction in AXe 2.0. An iOS team can ground each agent action in a fresh screen and require stale targets to fail before input; his thread says Xcode 27 is required and leaves iOS 26 compatibility untested, while the speed figures are the tool author’s own measurements.
takeaway: Pair the device, enable Developer Mode, and re-observe after screen changes; treat screenChanged as a signal to refresh references, then verify the resulting UI rather than trusting command success.
